The WTPs are 12M, 11M, 10M, 9M, 8M, 7M, 6M, 5M, 4M, etc.
The firm will sell 8 trips (or 9 if WTP equals cost, yielding zero additional profit). 
The profit from each trip is the WTP minus the 4M cost:
- 1st trip: 12M - 4M = 8M
- 2nd trip: 11M - 4M = 7M
- 3rd trip: 10M - 4M = 6M
- 4th trip: 9M - 4M = 5M
- 5th trip: 8M - 4M = 4M
- 6th trip: 7M - 4M = 3M
- 7th trip: 6M - 4M = 2M
- 8th trip: 5M - 4M = 1M
